goal: Refactor 7 engine modules (Group A) to route all direct DB writes through WriteQueue singleton per INV-31

steps.description: Read all 7 Group A modules and identify every direct DB write to trades/bot_orders tables
steps.stop_condition: Found all write sites in all 7 modules

steps.description: Read WriteQueue singleton API (write_queue.py) and ledger.py patterns to understand correct WriteQueue usage
steps.stop_condition: Understand put() vs put_and_wait() semantics and ledger.credit_fill/seal_trade_state patterns

steps.description: Map coupling: for each write site, determine if it can use existing ledger functions or needs new WriteQueue-wrapped function
steps.stop_condition: Complete mapping table: module -> write site -> target function (existing or new)

steps.description: Analyze ws_event_handlers.py's private _db_write_queue — design unification into WriteQueue singleton
steps.stop_condition: Clear design: how to replace queue.Queue with WriteQueue without changing WS event semantics

steps.description: Design new WriteQueue-wrapped functions in database.py or ledger.py for write patterns not covered by existing API
steps.stop_condition: List of new functions needed with signatures and which modules will call them

steps.description: Verify RULE #0 (one-way mode) and invariants — ensure no refactor breaks exchange-first ordering or atomicity
steps.stop_condition: Confirmed: all new paths respect INV-15, INV-31, RULE #0

steps.description: Create implementation plan per module (7 sub-plans) with exact diffs to apply, in dependency order
steps.stop_condition: 7 module-specific plans ready for conductor fan-out

stop_conditions: Cannot explain a discrepancy within 3 checks
No new information after 2 retries of same approach
Contradictory evidence that can't be resolved
Any module has write pattern that cannot be safely routed through WriteQueue
escalate_conditions: Need user decision on trade-off (e.g., performance vs correctness for high-frequency writes)
External dependency unavailable (exchange_interface/recovery design review needed)
Safety boundary reached (pre-placement guard, test-DB isolation guard)
